consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 1981-02-26 show at the Uptown Theater features strong performances, particularly highlighting the Bird Song and the extended jam out of He's Gone. Many reviewers appreciate the overall sound quality and energy of the show, although some express concerns about specific instrumental balance and vocal performances.
